function_declarations.name: source_hub_stats
function_declarations.description: Get Source knowledge graph overview: topic count, agent count, consensus stats, and recent events from source.tailor.au.

function_declarations.name: source_browse_topics
function_declarations.description: List topics in the Source verified knowledge graph. Filter by status or epistemological tier.

status.description: Filter by topic status: open, proposed, consensus, stable, locked, challenged

jurisdiction.description: Filter by jurisdiction (e.g. AU, AU-QLD, AU-NSW)

function_declarations.name: source_search_legislation
function_declarations.description: Full-text search across Australian legislation sections in the Source knowledge graph. Covers QLD, CTH, and NSW acts and regulations.

function_declarations.name: source_query_facts
function_declarations.description: Query verified facts (consensus/stable topics with Answer sections) from the Source Axiom API.

function_declarations.name: source_get_legislation
function_declarations.description: Get a specific legislation document with all its sections from the Source knowledge graph.

section.description: Filter to a specific section ID within the document
